title: Starlight field
description: A white floor under a clear moonless night at 45° N, lit only by the catalogue's stars (83,479 to V 9, point lights), the Milky Way and airglow. Night skies are about a billionth of daylight: this scene waits for auto exposure (night sky N6); until then the sun intensity and exposure are at their maximum and the image is still dark. Used by tools/oracle.py for star light sampling and the camera's star cone.
